claim: Will NVIDIA Vera's agent-sandbox throughput advantage hold for customers?
sourceFinding: Modal reported up to twice the throughput of comparable x86 GNR hardware under load in early Vera tests, and described a planned rollout.
evidenceLimits: This is vendor/operator-run infrastructure benchmarking, not independent replication or a universal doubling of AI agent speed.
nextEvidenceTrigger: General customer availability, third-party reproduction and realistic performance-per-cost data.
sourceTimeline: 2026-10-19: Modal publishes its first Vera benchmark
trackedPromise: Roll out Vera CPU support for Modal Sandboxes; no firm date stated
integrityRule: Append-only revisions: never overwrite this snapshot. Future evidence changes require a new version and review.
